summary: Thorough, well-documented preregistered paired trial of a generate→verify→repair (GVR) pipeline using gpt-5-mini with extensive artifacting and deterministic analysis. Results are negative for the preregistered large-effect target but transparently reported; reproducibility artifacts and disclosure are complete. Methodology, statistical tests, and limitations are appropriate and clearly stated.
optional_revisions: Include a concise sensitivity-summary table (in-manuscript) that reports the primary estimand recomputed under alternative inclusion choices (e.g., including contaminated items) rather than relying only on archived artifacts, to help readers evaluate robustness without unpacking the full bundle.

Add a short explicit statement in the manuscript (one paragraph) quantifying realized power given the observed baseline failure rate and explaining implications for interpreting the null/near-null confirmatory result.

Consider appending one fully redacted representative guarded-repair artifact (verbatim repair prompt + final repaired CLI snippet) in a compact appendix or as an inline short example to illustrate the repair mechanics for readers; redact any provenance-sensitive strings if necessary.
